Initial release with comprehensive PPTX presentation handling and design guidance.

- Triggers whenever any .pptx (presentation) file is to be created, edited, read, or used—including design, extraction, or modification tasks.
- Provides quick references and workflows for reading, editing, and creating slide decks from scratch.
- Includes practical design recommendations: color palettes, layouts, typography, and visual elements to avoid generic presentations.
- Emphasizes thorough QA: both content and visual, with recommended checks and instructions.
- Lists common mistakes to avoid for higher-quality, visually engaging slides.
